name: portego-upload
description: Create, validate, and upload HTML or Markdown artifacts in a configurable style.

origin.title: Portego deployment
origin.description: The address of your deployment, for example https://share.acme.example. Leave it empty to use the one set with `npx -y portego-upload auth <origin>`.

style.title: Artifact style
style.description: An optional path to an artifact style directory or manifest. Project and user styles are discovered automatically when this is empty.
